description.value: 5Forty Café & Bar is a full-service café and bar in the Sun Peaks resort village, offering breakfast, daily specials, and an extensive drinks menu spanning local craft beers on tap, cocktails, wine, and non-alcoholic options. Located at 3190 Creekside Way, it sits within the walkable core of the Sun Peaks resort community in the Thompson Okanagan region. Cyclists finishing a ride in the area will find a broad menu with something for most tastes, including specialty cocktails and several non-alcoholic choices.
